trigger: Only if pruitt_alive. Deshawn shows you the cistern.

nodes.speaker: deshawn
nodes.text: Ms. Dell. Grandpa says you're the gas-can lady. He said show you the basement.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A sealed concrete cistern from the 1920s, fed by an old well. Under a house. Under the ash.

nodes.speaker: deshawn
nodes.text: Grandpa says water's water if the sky can't touch it. He says that about a lot of stuff.

choices.text: Can we take some for Theo?

nodes.speaker: deshawn
nodes.text: He said you'd ask that. He said yes. He said 'she asked first, so yes.'

nodes.speaker: deshawn
nodes.text: Yeah. Take some. Grandpa says that's what it's for.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Clean water. For a while, the block doesn't have to choose between thirst and the RAD needle.
